title: Senior / Principal Product Manager, Contract Orchestration
description:
ABOUT ZIP

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement - built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Please note we are looking for someone who is willing and able to come into our downtown San Francisco office on a hybrid basis (3 days / week).

YOUR ROLE

We're hiring a Senior/Principal Product Manager (experience dependent) to lead Zip's Contract Orchestration product, one of the company's newest and most strategic bets. Buy-side contracting is still broken: reviews and redlines live in email threads, signed agreements disappear into shared drives, and requesters call the process a black box. Zip's customers execute over a million contract reviews a year and most of them are routine agreements. We just launched AI Contract Orchestration to take that work off legal and procurement, and there is far more to build.

You'll own the vision and strategy for one or more areas of this product, end to end and with a high degree of autonomy. The category is established, but Zip has an edge: as the front door for procurement, we see every contract with clean intake data on the requester, spend, category, and risk, so our AI can review clauses, propose redlines, and route work on real context rather than the document alone. As PM, you'll balance different users' interests throughout the contracting process (procurement, legal, finance, requesters, suppliers), and you'll own the quality bar that lets legal trust AI with language that carries real liability.

YOU WILL

- Set the vision and multi-quarter strategy for Contract Orchestration, with a clear, opinionated view of where we beat incumbent CLMs

- Ship AI that does the work: clause analysis, playbook-grounded redlines, contract generation, triage and routing, and metadata extraction accurate enough to trust

- Own the full lifecycle, from intake and negotiation to the repository, contract families, renewals, and contract-to-spend compliance

- Work directly with customers to ship features that reduce contract cycle times and increase contract visibility and compliance

- Build agents and own the AI quality bar end to end: evals, guardrails, and feedback loops

- Roll up your sleeves wherever the team needs it, from user research to reviewing extraction quality on a customer's contracts

QUALIFICATIONS

- 4 - 8+ years of Product Management experience, preferably in B2B SaaS, owning ambiguous, high-impact areas end to end

- Deep experience partnering with engineering and design to ship sophisticated products with a great user experience

- Experience with workflow or document-heavy enterprise products

- A track record of setting product strategy and influencing cross-functional partners and leadership without direct authority

- Experience shipping AI or ML features where accuracy is non-negotiable, including how you measured and improved quality

- Strong written and verbal communication with internal and external stakeholders, including executives

- Extreme attention to detail, with the ability to quickly grasp complex business processes and industry knowledge

- Ability to prioritize ruthlessly, even if it may disappoint customers or stakeholders

title: Director, Paid Social (Reddit Emphasis)

The Role
This is a wedge hire. You're not joining an established paid social team - you're building one. On day one you own Reddit ads as a new client service line and run Siege's own paid social and retargeting. As Reddit ads books revenue, you'll hire and lead a team underneath you.
This is a senior, client-facing role. You'll pitch on sales calls, strategize campaigns, get hands-on in the platforms early in the lifespan of the service offering, and write the reports clients actually read. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who enjoys both strategy and execution. If you want to build a practice from scratch with the runway and brand of an established agency behind you, this role is for you.
Responsibilities

• Reddit Ads (Primary): Own strategy, setup, optimization, and reporting for Siege clients. Build the playbook, pricing scaffolds, and reporting cadence from zero.

• Siege's Paid Social: Retarget engaged leads and run Meta/LinkedIn campaigns that feed our own sales pipeline.

• Sales Support: Join prospect calls to scope and sell paid social engagements alongside the growth team.

• Team Building: Hire your first associate when Reddit ads revenue justifies it, then train and manage them to Siege's senior-led standard. Own and execute directly until then.

• Service Infrastructure: Develop the templates, QA processes, attribution approach, and reporting standards that turn paid social into a repeatable, sellable service line.

Required Skills

• 5+ years running paid social campaigns in an agency environment - ideally a mix of Reddit, LinkedIn, and Meta

• Hands-on Reddit Ads Manager experience (Conversation Ads, Promoted Posts, custom audiences) and a point of view on who the platform is and isn’t a fit for

• Proven B2B and B2C experience, especially within SaaS, e-commerce, and fintech. You know the difference between optimizing for clicks and optimizing for pipeline

• Demonstrated client-facing comfort - you can walk a VP of Marketing through a quarterly review without flinching

• Strong written communication. Clients see your work directly; we don't have account managers translating between you and them

• "Builder energy" and a genuine excitement about helping build and scale a service line from scratch. You can execute and advise on campaigns to keep the department profitable early on

Suggested Skills

• Experience with ChatGPT ads

• Prior experience building or scaling a paid social practice inside an agency environment

• Familiarity with B2B attribution headaches (multi-touch, dark social, self-reported attribution)

• An active client network in paid social within our client base

Compensation & Logistics

• Salary: $115,000.00-$130,000.00 USD base | $135,000.00-$155,000.00 USD OTE

title: Head of CRO – Conversion Rate Optimization (m/w/d)
description:

Millions of people see our ads. Visit our landing pages. Browse our products. Add them to their carts.

Your job is to turn more of them into customers.

In just four years, Pammys has grown to more than 1 million customers . Today, over 150 employees are working to turn Pammys into an international footwear brand.

At our scale, even small improvements in conversion rate can have a significant impact on revenue.

That’s exactly why we’re building CRO as a dedicated function.

From the first landing page to PDP, cart, and checkout.

You’ll have high traffic volumes, large amounts of data, and the ability to test quickly.

No optimization based on gut feeling.

You develop hypotheses. You test. You measure. You learn. You scale what works.

And you’re not optimizing for the highest possible conversion rate alone.

You’re optimizing for profitable growth

• Confident using GA4, heatmaps, session recordings, and web analytics

title: Clinical Psychologist / Counselor (Massachusetts, US)
description:
Intellect Care (Counselling/ Psychotherapy) is a collaborative process to guide, explore and/or resolve personal, social, or psychological problems and difficulties.
Counselling is most useful when clients seek tools or techniques to support their mental health. Psychotherapy identifies unhelpful patterns of thinking and behaviours which may limit the client's quality of life or daily activities and equip clients with more helpful and effective ways of thinking, behaving and relating to others. This addresses moderately severe mental health experiences. Intellect Care normally spans up to 60 minutes
Why Join Us?
Become part of a collaborative network of Clinical Psychologists and Counsellors dedicated to expanding access to quality mental health care. At Intellect, you’ll find a supportive community focused on enhancing lives and helping clients overcome personal challenges.
What You'll Do

• Provide 1-on-1 telehealth/or onsite mental health support for Intellect’s clients

• Address a range of clinical cases, including depression, anxiety, trauma, schizophrenia, eating disorders, addiction, and more

• Partner with our internal clinical team to improve the platform and client programs

Requirements
For Counselors

• Hold an active Massachusetts Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC) license

• Be licensed through the Massachusetts Board of Registration of Allied Mental Health and Human Services Professions

• Hold a Master’s degree in Counseling or a related field

• Have completed:

• 60 semester hours of graduate education

• 3,360 hours of post-master’s supervised experience over a minimum of 2 years

• Have passed the NCMHCE examination

For Psychologists

• Hold an active Massachusetts Psychologist license

• Be licensed through the Massachusetts Board of Registration of Psychologists

• Hold a doctoral degree (Ph.D. or Psy.D.) from an accredited program

• Have completed:

• 2 years of supervised experience

• At least 1 year of post-doctoral supervised practice

• Have passed:

• Examination for Professional Practice in Psychology (EPPP)

• Massachusetts jurisprudence examination

• Expertise: Skilled in Cognitive Behavioral Therapy or other evidence-based approaches (e.g., Motivational Interviewing, DBT, SFBT)

• Languages: Proficiency in English and your local language

• Preferred Background: Prior experience with EAP, adult counseling, or coaching in managerial roles

• Flexibility: Openness to ocassional onsite work, if necessary

Benefits
This is more than a job. It's your chance to:

• Work with a global provider network

• Broaden your clientele base beyond local users

• Grow your career outside of sessions through research, content, and webinars

• Access supervision & CE most EAP's don't provide

If you’re ready to make a meaningful impact and be part of a mission-driven team, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and join us in transforming mental health care!

title: Sales Development Representative - US Cold Calling
description:
About the role
Division 50 runs outbound sales development for our clients - companies across many different industries who hire us to fill their calendars with qualified meetings. As a US Cold Calling SDR, you sit on the phones every day calling into the US market on behalf of those clients. You learn each client's product, ideal customer, and pitch, then dial their target accounts, get past the brush-off, and book qualified meetings their closers actually show up for.
This is a phone-first role. You are not selling Division 50's own services - you represent our clients. The work changes as our client roster changes, so you ramp fast on new products and industries and keep your numbers steady through the switch. This is fully remote, working US business hours.
What you'll do

• Make high-volume cold calls into the US market on behalf of Division 50 clients across different industries (B2B SaaS, professional services, home services, healthcare, finance, and more)

• Learn each client's offer, ideal customer profile, and objection patterns quickly, and adapt your pitch to whoever you're calling that week

• Open cold calls that start with a brush-off, hold the line, and turn them into booked, qualified meetings

• Qualify prospects against each client's criteria before you book, so the meetings that land on a closer's calendar are real

• Log every dial, conversation, and booked meeting in the CRM so the client and your manager can see the activity

title: Crisis Helpline Responder (Australia)
description:
Are you passionate about making a difference for those in urgent need? As a Crisis Helpline Responder, you’ll provide immediate support and guidance to individuals in crisis, offering compassionate listening, crisis intervention, and critical referral services to help callers navigate their most challenging moments.
In this role, you’ll work closely with a dedicated team of mental health professionals, ensuring the safety and well-being of callers by connecting them with the appropriate resources and support systems.
This flexible, remote part-time role allows you to work from anywhere. While we prefer local candidates fluent in the local language, we welcome all qualified applicants aligned with our mission.
Why This Role Matters
Your role is essential in providing a lifeline to individuals experiencing distress, including those affected by suicide, self-harm, or mental health crises. You’ll be trained in evidence-based techniques to deliver immediate relief and guide callers to the appropriate resources, making a tangible impact in people’s lives.
Responsibilities

• Responding to telephone hotline for crisis support of those bereaved through suicide, engaging in self-harm, experiencing suicide ideation and concerned friends or family members.

• Conducting over the phone risk assessments and high risk assessment, including but not limited to, lethality assessment for suicide cases or individuals who have been found to be at risk.

• Providing a range of evidenced based, professional crisis counseling services and personal support, employing de-escalation techniques and crisis intervention techniques

• Assessing the caller's needs and triage for immediate safety or emergency medical attention of callers, or referrals to appropriate service referrals such as face-to-face crisis intervention, case management/advocacy services, individual therapy, or group services.

• Maintaining accurate and detailed call reports or, where applicable risk assessment reports, on key issues and referrals actioned.

• Where applicable or necessary, sign off on conducted risk assessments.

• Complying with responsibilities under the Data Protection Acts 1988, 2003 & 2018 (GDPR)

• Supporting in the development of appropriate crisis management plans to support callers in crisis.

• Make a quick in-the-moment decision on how to move forward if the responder is not sure how to proceed

• Ensuring smooth and diligent handover process to next shift personnel

• Dedicating entire shift to intellect tasks and responsibilities only

• Prepare psychological reports, risk summaries, and other clinical documentation as required

Requirements

Qualifications

• Master's Degree in Counselling/Counselling Psychology/Clinical Psychology or relevant mental health fields

• Active license with Australian Counselling Association (ACA), Psychotherapy and Counselling Federation of Australia (PACFA), or Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA)

• 1-3 years of experience on helplines (paid or volunteer), preferably in mental health or crisis settings

• Fluent communication skills in your native language; proficiency in additional languages is a plus

• Experience managing high-risk situations, including those at risk of suicide or in acute crisis

• Resilience and emotional composure under pressure, with the ability to recover from challenging interactionsations, ability to bounce back from stressful interactions and high-risk case

• Experience in clinical assessment, psychological report writing, and risk documentation

Preferred Qualifications

• Background in mental health or emergency services

• Completed training in Crisis Intervention or Suicide Prevention

• Proficiency in multiple languages

title: Software Engineer
description:
Smartcuts is building a browser extension that turns your clicks and keystrokes into shareable, no-code automations (1-minute video). We're looking for individuals who approach their craft with curiosity, clarity, and an appetite to learn to join our tiny but mighty distributed team.

Smartcuts investors include Y Combinator, SignalFire, and prominent angels including the founders of Fitbit, Hubspot, Lyft, and Segment.
We use ReasonML, ReScript, Next.js, Vercel, GraphQL, and the serverless database Fauna. Our choices were built on a preference for strongly typed, functional languages and for serverless architectures -- choices that allow us to focus on the necessary, not the incidental, complexity of the problem space.
Some of the interesting engineering and design challenges in this problem space?

• How do you design a product that doesn't expose engineering concepts to users?

• How can you design an algorithm that can reliably locate elements on a page, without asking the user to specify css selectors?

• How can you leverage AI to automatically detect and extract structured records from a web page?

title: Billing Manager
description:
BILLING MANAGER

Our Mission For You

Own the invoicing engine of a hyper-growth energy-tech company. Your work directly protects our cash flow and keeps our growth engine running. Invoicing directly affects our cash flow in the millions. This role is a lever, not a cost center.

trawa enables mid-sized companies to access green, intelligent energy. We're a hyper-growth company with strong team growth, rising invoice volumes, and increasing complexity per invoice. Individual contracts, PPAs, spot, futures, EEG direct marketing, grid fees, taxes: every customer segment is a small puzzle. Today, that puzzle is solved mostly manually, and it needs to move to the next level.

You'll build order out of that complexity. You'll jump into individual invoices when it matters. At the same time, you'll design the process that makes those individual jumps unnecessary. You'll be part of our Billing Tool Rollout and help prepare invoicing for our ERP migration. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to own the operation, not just manage it.

What You'll Own

Own Invoicing End-to-End

- Own daily invoicing processes to trawa customers: quality, completeness, timing

- Reduce and eliminate our current ticket backlog through prioritization, root-cause analysis, and systematic execution

- Ensure complex billing logic (PPA, spot, futures, EEG direct marketing, grid fees, taxes) is correctly reflected in every invoice

- Own the invoicing KPIs: on-time rate, error rate, ticket aging, time-to-invoice

Build Scalable Processes

- Be part of designing and rolling out a scalable invoicing architecture, from today's manual setup to a standardized and automated solution

- Automate recurring process steps

- Document everything: reproducible, hand-off-ready, audit-ready

Stakeholder & Customer Communication

- Direct customer communication on invoicing questions, in writing (German and English)

- Partner closely with Sales and Customer Success to secure upstream data quality (contracts, prices, delivery points)

- Partner closely with our Tech/Data team, where consumption data, time series, and energy accruals are your input

- Establish escalation paths and priority logic with Sales and CS, so edge cases don't block the standard process

Data Quality & Handover to Accounting

- Ensure invoicing data flows cleanly into accounting, as the interface to our accounting team

- Contribute to month-end close: clean invoicing cut-off, documented open items, accruals-relevant data ready on time

- Audit-readiness from an invoicing perspective: process documentation, invoice-level traceability, controls

Your First 90 Days

Month 1, Land & Understand. Understand our business model, the German energy market basics, and our billing complexity. Understand what drives our corrections rate. Build relationships with the most important stakeholders.

Month 2, Stabilize. Keep invoicing running stably while spotting optimization opportunities. Define clear ticket priorities and escalation paths with Sales and CS. Ship first quick wins in automation and process design. Define and start tracking your KPIs: error rate, ticket aging.

Month 3, Build. Deliver a target process architecture for improvements to our current invoicing processes. Actively and proactively reduce time-to-invoice and corrections rates. Present your automation and process roadmap to the finance leadership team.

Who You Are

Must-haves

- 3+ years in Billing, Order-to-Cash, Finance Operations, or similar operational Finance roles

- Scale-up experience, with at least one station at a fast-growing company. You've worked without a clean ERP, with ambiguous processes, in a team being built as it runs

- B2B billing with complex pricing models, not SaaS flat-rate. You've handled individual contracts, volume-based logic, or formula-driven pricing

- Proven high-output track record. You've personally delivered and you can point to a moment where you built or saved a critical process

- Systems thin

title: People Operations Lead
description:
ABOUT FLOCK

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we're changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK's leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We're growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we're hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We're on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll own the people engine room at Flock: the employee lifecycle, payroll input, benefits, the HRIS, the office and our in-person events. Your job is to design how a modern People function should work at a company where repetitive admin is automated out of existence and every process is simple, scalable and AI-native by default. You'll report to our Senior People Partner and work with everyone here, from a new joiner on day one to the CEO, who cares deeply about our culture.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

People Operations

- Own the full employee lifecycle: contracts, right-to-work, starter and leaver logistics, probations and changes. Shape the first day and first week alongside managers, delivering a strong employee experience across the lifecycle.

- Be the first point of contact for people queries and audits. Own the People inbox and core HR templates, and drive every query to resolution.

- Own the HRIS (HiBob) and people data: records, workflows, surveys and data integrity. Deliver monthly People reporting and metrics that spot and close gaps early.

- Own benefits end to end as the main contact for providers, systems, data and employee advice, keeping policies and materials current.

- Cut manual effort across the lifecycle by building AI-native workflows, so every routine people process is automated by default, then coach the business to use them. Own continuous improvement across People Ops.

- Partner with IT on joiner and leaver access automation, and on cost and data audits.

Office Management & Socials

- Run the office environment and vendor relationships, including routine upkeep like weekly snack orders and post. Cover health and safety as a trained First Aider and Fire Marshal, and provision hardware fast.

- Own the company social calendar and rituals, from bi-weekly Flock o'Clock (working closely with the CEO) to quarterly Town Halls and larger events, keeping them engaging and on budget.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

- Hands-on People or HR Operations experience, ideally in a fast-moving scale-up, with real ownership of end-to-end processes. CIPD or equivalent experience required.

- Hands-on payroll input and benefits administration. HiBob experience is a plus.

- Strong HRIS skills across workflows, automations and integrations, plus confident data and spreadsheet ability.

- Real evidence of building with AI: workflows or tools you've shipped and use, not ones you've only read about.

- Exceptional organisation and judgement. You spot what needs doing and get ahead of it, you build the credibility that lets you influence without leaning on authority, and you treat confidential matters with discretion.

- Working knowledge of UK employment law, compliance and people governance.

- Low ego and high standards. You care most that the work is right and well run.

title: Sales Development Representative (SDR) | Private Markets

bunch https://www.bunch.capital/ is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

YOUR ROLE

We’re hiring a Sales Development Representative to own the front half of our sales funnel-but this isn’t a pure dial-for-dollars role. You’ll generate and qualify pipeline from fund managers across venture capital and private equity, while partnering hands-on with our Account Executives as deals move through the middle of the funnel.

You’ll help prepare specialised decks, tailor materials, and keep opportunities moving. This is a role for someone who wants full visibility into how a B2B sales cycle works, not just the first five minutes of it.

TOP OF FUNNEL

- Research and prioritise target accounts by assets under management, fund stage, vehicle type, and geography

- Own and maintain signal sources such as new-fund announcements and regulator registers, including BaFin, the FCA, and the CSSF

- Run outbound campaigns across email, LinkedIn, and calls to generate qualified conversations for accounts not already activated by Account Executives

- Qualify inbound leads against our ideal customer profile and book meetings for Account Executives

- Keep HubSpot pristine, with accurate stages, notes, and next steps for every touchpoint

- Deliver against weekly and monthly activity and pipeline-generation targets

MID FUNNEL

- Partner with Account Executives to prepare for deep dives and workshops by pulling together GP and fund research, competitive context, and meeting briefs

- Build and tailor pitch decks, one-pagers, and proposal materials for specific prospects

- Track deal status alongside Account Executives so opportunities do not stall for lack of a document, follow-up, or clear next step

ABOUT YOU

- 1-3 years of experience in an SDR, BDR, or sales-support role, ideally in private markets, fintech, or financial services

- Sales Navigator, HubSpot, and AI tools such as Claude, Granola, or equivalent are part of your daily workbench-not occasional aids

- You can build repeatable systems to monitor signals across regulator registers and hundreds of accounts rather than working through them manually

- Comfortable writing sharp outbound copy and building clean, persuasive decks in Google Slides

- Strong organisational instincts-you keep details, documents, and next steps from falling through the cracks

- Genuine curiosity about private markets and fund structures; prior exposure to venture capital, private equity, or fund administration is a strong plus, not a requirement

- CRM fluency, with HubSpot preferred

- Excellent written and verbal English

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience selling to fund managers, general partners, or asset managers

- Familiarity with fund administration, compliance, or fund-operations concepts

WORKPLACE & BENEFITS

- Customisable benefits package covering wellbeing, sport, mobility, food, and more

- 28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays

- Up to 6 remote calendar weeks a year

- A great tech and work setup

- Work with a diverse team of 130+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains

HIRING PROCESS

1. People Team Interview (30 min) - Meet us, share what you’re looking for, and explore whether the role and bunch feel like the right mutual fit.

2. Commercial Deep Dive (30 min) - Discuss your sales experience, how you create and qualify pipeline, and how you partner with AEs to move opportunities forward.

3. Case Study with our Head of Sales (45 min) - Work through a practical, role-relevant scenario and show how you research accounts, prioritise opportunities, communicate clearly, and turn information into action.

Job Title: ​
Manager, Actuarial Services - Tools & Models
Job Description: ​
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship, now or in the future.
The Actuarial Manager, Tools and Models will own the core actuarial models and tools used for reserving and forecasting claims across agilon's Medicare Advantage (MA) and value-based care populations. The Manager will help support the development of actuarial analysts through direct management and project leadership. The Manager will actively monitor and assess data quality, drive enhancements to Medical Margin Models, and enhance standardized reporting tools for close results at the market and national levels.
The Manager will play a central role in the annual budget process, including trend studies and the use of payor bid data to quantify year-over-year benefit changes and recommend trend adjustments for benefit relativity. As CMS transitions the ACO REACH program to ACO LEAD, the Manager will help design and build the actuarial models supporting the new program.
This is a fully remote position, with minimal required travel. This role reports to the Sr. Director for the Central Actuarial team. The Central team develops and maintains models, tools, and methodology that underpin the monthly close process that is carried out by the Markets team. The role is critical to the operations of the Actuarial team, and the Manager will be a key leader within the Actuarial and broader Data Solutions organization.
Essential Job Functions:

• Develop and maintain actuarial models and tools

• Actively monitor and assess data quality

• Drive enhancements to Medical Margin Models, including IBNR and revenue accrual methodology

• Evaluate and set claims completion factors quarterly for national payors

• Develop and maintain standardized reporting tools for close results utilizing statements data and/or payor data feeds

• Support development of the annual budget, including trend studies and key claims assumptions

title: AI Engineer – Agentic AI & Cloud Discovery
description:
Location: India, Remote-First
Employment: Full-Time
Start Date: November 2026
Experience: 4+ years
Language: Fluent English required
Industry: Cybersecurity / Enterprise SaaS / AI Security
About the Opportunity
Pragmatike is recruiting on behalf of a global enterprise cybersecurity company building a new generation of products to secure AI agents, LLM-powered applications, and the data they access .
The engineering organization is scaling rapidly in India, with two AI Engineer openings focused on turning AI and machine learning capabilities into reliable, production-grade security products .
We're looking for engineers who are equally comfortable building production services in Go and developing LLM/ML pipelines in Python , with the ability to move quickly from experimentation to hardened production systems.
You'll join one of two workstreams:

•
Agentic AI Forensics: Turn agent traces, prompts, tool calls, and security events into structured, explainable findings for security analysts using LLM reasoning, RAG, structured extraction, and rigorous evaluation.

•
Cloud Discovery: Classify cloud resources and workloads to identify AI agents, model endpoints, and AI-enabled applications, while inferring their purpose and security risk using LLM/ML classification at scale.

Both workstreams share the same foundations: Go for production services, Python for experimentation and data pipelines, LLM APIs, rigorous evaluation, and cloud-native deployment.
What You'll Do

• Design and build LLM-powered analysis and classification pipelines, then productionize them as Go services.

• Prototype approaches in Python, including prompting strategies, RAG, structured extraction, and ML classifiers, and ship solutions that meet defined accuracy targets.

• Define ground-truth datasets, evaluation metrics, and regression suites to continuously measure and improve model quality.

• Monitor model quality and drift in production and build processes to identify and address degradation.

• Collaborate with security researchers to translate attack patterns and risk signals into detection and summarization logic.

• Integrate AI-powered capabilities with event, storage, and UI layers to surface actionable results to security teams.

• Use AI-assisted development workflows to accelerate implementation, testing, debugging, and experimentation.

What We're Looking For

•
4+ years of software engineering experience, including 2+ years shipping LLM- or ML-backed features to production .

• Strong Go skills for production backend services and strong Python skills for experimentation and data pipelines.

• Hands-on experience with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, structured outputs, and RAG .

• Experience evaluating LLM/ML systems through offline evaluations, human review, regression suites, or similar approaches.

• Understanding of AI agent architectures , including tool calling, MCP or similar protocols, multi-step planning, and common failure modes.

• Experience with cloud-native deployment using Docker, Kubernetes , and AWS, GCP, or Azure.

• Fluent English with strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Comfortable using modern AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Codex, or similar. This is a must-have.

• Strong ownership and the ability to work independently in a remote-first, distributed environment.

Nice to Have

• Background in security analytics, SIEM/SOAR, or digital forensics .

• Practical knowledge of major cloud provider APIs, IAM models, and resource inventory.

• Experience with vector databases, embedding pipelines, or model fine-tuning for classification or extraction.

• Familiarity with tracing AI applications and OpenTelemetry-style observability.

• Previous experience in cybersecurity, security tooling, or trust & safety.

• Experience introducing AI-assisted or agentic development workflows across engineering teams.

AI-First Engineering
AI is a core part of the engineering workflow on this team.

title: Senior Engineering Manager
description:
WHO WE ARE

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, Booking.com http://Booking.com, H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank.

In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you.

Engineering leadership is the lever for this next stage. As Imprint expands into new financial products, launches new brand partnerships, and scales the infrastructure underneath all of it, the quality of our engineering teams determines the quality of everything we ship. AI has made execution faster; the differentiator is the judgment to decide what to build, how to sequence it, and when to say no. That judgment, applied to how teams are built, how they make decisions, and how they're managed, is what Senior Engineering Managers own.

THE OPPORTUNITY

- Bring structure to complex, ambiguous domains: Imprint's products sit at the intersection of payments, credit, compliance, and brand strategy. You'll lead a team through problems that aren't fully scoped, where the right answer requires synthesizing technical constraints with product, legal, and financial realities.

- Operate as a true cross-functional partner: Not just "align with product." You'll work directly with product, compliance, legal, capital markets, and solutions engineering on decisions where the lanes overlap significantly. You will help represent Engineering in the room when strategy is set.

- Lead with technical credibility, amplified by AI: AI has collapsed the distance between management and IC work. Managers at Imprint use AI tools to investigate codebases, assess the complexity and viability of work, and bring clarity to ambiguous asks. You don't need to be on the critical path writing code (though some managers are), but you need real technical judgment and the modern tools to exercise it.

- Build and develop a team as a craft: You have a real philosophy on how to hire, develop, and retain strong engineers. You have opinions on how work is scoped and delivered, how to balance short and long-term priorities, and how to give feedback that actually changes outcomes. Clear communication, written and verbal, is key.

- Operate in the details: This is not a role where technical context and project management are abstracted to other roles or organizational layers. You define the roadmap, scope the work, and manage individuals to outcomes. Even if you've led multiple teams before, the question is: can you take a new team and run it end-to-end?

- Own outcomes at a company in a defining growth moment: Imprint is growing rapidly, launching new products, and deepening our platform. You'll have the scope and autonomy to shape how your team builds, and your work will be visible in the trajectory of the business.

title: Senior ML Applied Scientist
description:
Intuition Machines uses AI/ML to build enterprise security products. We apply our research to systems that serve hundreds of millions of people, with a team distributed around the world. You are probably familiar with our best-known product, the hCaptcha security suite. Our approach is simple: low overhead, small teams, and rapid iteration.

As an ML Applied Scientist, you will design, implement, and scale machine learning systems that power our products. You’ll work across teams to translate business goals into technical specifications, ensuring our models perform efficiently under real-world constraints. This role combines research, engineering, and mentorship in a fast-paced production environment.

Using AI: Coding agents are indisputably useful tools. We provide access to the top 3 models, and were early adopters of evals-first development flows. Familiarity with coding using agents is part of all interviews. However, reliability and correctness are critical for us. You will need to read and understand every line of code with your name on it, and it will be reviewed by both people and machines.

What you will do:

• Build ML models that can scale to millions of requests per second while maintaining performance.

• Translate business requirements into technical specifications.

• Develop ML models that satisfy memory and compute constraints, evaluate them properly, and debug effectively.

• Provide technical mentorship to other ML research engineers.

• Iterate quickly, with a focus on shipping early and often, ensuring that new products or features can be deployed to millions of users.

• Write clearly structured, maintainable, well-documented, and tested code, including unit, integration, and end-to-end tests.

• Participate in code reviews and architecture & design sessions. Stay updated on recent technological developments and assess their applicability.

• Provide technical input to the research roadmap.

What we are looking for:

• 5+ years of professional experience in applied ML.

• Proven experience with the entire modeling lifecycle: building, evaluating, and debugging large ML models.

• Experience with large-scale categorical and structured data.

• Expertise in real-time ML models, incremental learning, and online learning.

• Strong understanding of ML fundamentals: bias-variance tradeoffs, loss functions, evaluation metrics, etc.

• Bachelor’s degree in a technical field (or equivalent practical experience).

• Thoughtful, self-directed individual who is comfortable making technical decisions independently.

Nice to Have:

• Strong grasp of the math required for ML (linear algebra, probability theory, statistics, matrix calculus).

• Software engineering/development experience with large-scale distributed systems.

• Ability to collaborate with ML engineers to integrate your work into our infrastructure, including automating observability, deployment, quality, and security.

What we offer:

• Fully remote position with flexible working hours.

• An inspiring team of colleagues spread all over the world.

• Pleasant, modern development and deployment workflows: ship early, ship often.

• High impact: lots of users, happy customers, high growth, and cutting edge R&D.

• Flat organization, direct interaction with customer teams.

We celebrate equality of opportunity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members.
Join us as we transform cybersecurity, user privacy, and machine learning online!
Please note that all positions require pre-employment screening, including third-party verification of work history, education, and identity, as well as a final in-person interview and identity verification step, which will be conducted in your country of residence.

title: Social Worker – Mental Health
description:
Our client based in Neath Port Talbot is seeking an experienced Social Worker to join their Mental Health Team. This is an excellent opportunity for a skilled practitioner to work with adults experiencing mental health needs, supporting them to achieve positive outcomes, maximise independence, and improve their wellbeing through strengths-based and person-centred practice.

The successful candidate will work closely with individuals, carers, families, health professionals, and partner agencies to assess needs, coordinate services, manage risk, and develop effective support plans. Working within a multidisciplinary environment, you will play a key role in safeguarding vulnerable adults, promoting recovery, facilitating access to community resources, and ensuring individuals remain at the centre of all decision-making.

This role requires a confident Social Worker with strong assessment skills, experience of complex case management, and a comprehensive understanding of mental health practice, safeguarding, capacity assessments, and partnership working.

What will your responsibilities be?

In this role, you will:

• Managing a complex caseload of adults with mental health needs, ensuring timely and effective social work interventions.

• Undertaking strengths-based assessments in partnership with individuals, families, carers, and professionals to identify needs, risks, and desired outcomes.

• Developing, implementing, coordinating, and reviewing person-centred care and support plans that promote recovery, independence, and wellbeing.

• Identifying and utilising community resources, natural support networks, and local services to support individuals in achieving their outcomes.

• Working collaboratively with health professionals, partner agencies, carers, and community organisations to deliver coordinated care and support.

• Undertaking Mental Capacity Assessments and facilitating Best Interest decision-making in accordance with the Mental Capacity Act.

• Completing Continuing Healthcare (CHC) assessments and contributing to multidisciplinary eligibility processes where required.

• Undertaking safeguarding enquiries and initiating appropriate action to protect adults at risk from abuse, neglect, exploitation, and self-neglect.

• Carrying out risk assessments and applying Positive Risk Taking principles to support individuals safely and effectively.

• Conducting non-criminal investigations as part of Adult at Risk processes and safeguarding procedures.

• Attending and contributing to case conferences, multidisciplinary meetings, reviews, and safeguarding meetings, providing a professional social work perspective.

title: Vertriebsmitarbeiter (m/w/d) in der Telefonakquise
description:
Hörer in die Hand, wählen, pitchen, Termin. Nochmal. Und nochmal. Und am Ende des Tages weißt du genau, was du geleistet hast - weil deine Ergebnisse messbar sind. Wenn sich das für dich nicht nach Arbeit, sondern nach Antrieb anhört, dann lies weiter.
Wir suchen keinen, der Kaltakquise „auch mal machen kann". Wir suchen jemanden, der sie liebt. Der den Kick spürt, wenn ein Entscheider nach 30 Sekunden zuhört statt aufzulegen. Der Einwände nicht als Problem sieht, sondern als Spielfeld.
Bei Clementine Media helfen wir Kommunen in ganz Deutschland, ihre offenen Stellen zu besetzen - mithilfe von Neuro-Recruiting, das wirklich funktioniert.
Über 150 Städte und Gemeinden vertrauen uns bereits. Dein Job: Bürgermeister, Hauptamtsleiter und Personalchefs ans Telefon bekommen und qualifizierte Termine für unser Vertriebsteam setzen.
Du öffnest die Tür - wir machen den Rest.
Aufgaben

• Du kontaktierst proaktiv Städte, Gemeinden und Landkreise per Telefon und identifizierst den richtigen Ansprechpartner (Bürgermeister, Geschäftsführer, Hauptamtsleiter, Personalverantwortliche).

• Du führst professionelle Erstgespräche am Telefon, weckst Interesse an unserer Recruiting-Lösung und positionierst Clementine Media als kompetenten Partner.

• Du vereinbarst qualifizierte Termine - das ist dein zentrales Ziel und deine wichtigste Kennzahl.

• Du pflegst deine Kontakte und Gesprächsergebnisse sauber in unserem CRM-System (Close CRM) und hältst deine Pipeline aktuell.

• Du arbeitest mit einem erprobten Gesprächsleitfaden, den du mit der Zeit zu deinem eigenen machst und kontinuierlich verbesserst.

• Du wirkst aktiv bei der Optimierung unser Vertriebsprozesse mit.

Qualifikation

• Du hast Erfahrung in der telefonischen Kaltakquise, im Telefonvertrieb oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle (z. B. SDR, BDR, Call Agent, Terminierung) - idealerweise im B2B-Umfeld.

• Du sprichst fließend Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau - am Telefon klingst du professionell, sympathisch und überzeugend.

• Du hast keine Scheu vor dem Hörer und lässt dich von einem „Nein" nicht aus der Ruhe bringen. Hartnäckigkeit mit Fingerspitzengefühl ist deine Stärke.

• Du arbeitest strukturiert, organisierst dich selbstständig und behältst auch bei hohem Anrufvolumen den Überblick.

• Du bist sicher im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen und digitalen Tools.

• Erfahrung im öffentlichen Sektor oder Kommunalvertrieb ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss - wir bringen dir alles Nötige bei.

Benefits

•
100 % Remote - arbeite von dort, wo du am produktivsten bist (innerhalb Deutschlands).

•
Erprobtes System - du bekommst einen bewährten Gesprächsleitfaden, Schulungen und ein CRM, das für dich arbeitet.

•
Sinnvolle Arbeit - du hilfst Kommunen, die Menschen zu finden, die den öffentlichen Dienst am Laufen halten: Erzieher, Ingenieure, Verwaltungskräfte.

•
Wachsendes Unternehmen - über 130 Kommunen vertrauen uns bereits. Sei Teil unseres nächsten Wachstumsschritts.

•
Attraktive Vergütung ohne Deckel - solides Fixgehalt plus unbegrenzte Provisionen. Je mehr qualifizierte Termine du setzt, desto mehr verdienst du - ohne Obergrenze.

•
Kurze Wege, flache Hierarchien - du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen und hast echten Einfluss.

Du brauchst kein langes Anschreiben. Bewirb dich einfach - wir melden uns schnell. Wenn du der Typ bist, der lieber anruft als E-Mails zu schreiben, dann zeig uns genau das. Wir freuen uns, von dir zu hören.

description:
🚀 Únete al claustro de preparadores de Polaris x Ucademy

¿Eres trabajador/a social, educador/a social u otro profesional del ámbito social con plaza, o preparas estas oposiciones? Colabora en remoto con Polaris x Ucademy .
🤝 Buscamos preparadores/as para las oposiciones del Área Social
Queremos construir un claustro de preparadores especializados en el Área Social , en el que cada profesional aporte su experiencia en su categoría y en las administraciones que mejor conoce.
No necesitas dominar todas las oposiciones ni todas las administraciones. Buscamos a quien conozca a fondo una o varias.
📚 Oposiciones para las que buscamos preparadores
⭐ Categorías principales

• Trabajo Social (A2)

• Educación Social (A2)

También buscamos preparadores de

• Psicología (A1)

• Terapia Ocupacional (A2)

• Integración Social (C1 / Técnico Superior)

• Animación Sociocultural (C1 / Técnico Superior)

🏛️ Una misma profesión, muchas convocatorias
Estas oposiciones las convocan administraciones muy distintas, y cada una tiene su temario, su legislación y su forma de examinar. Trabajo Social, por ejemplo, puede salir en el Estado, en una comunidad autónoma, en un ayuntamiento, en Instituciones Penitenciarias, en la Seguridad Social o en un servicio de salud.
Por eso buscamos especialmente preparadores que conozcan procesos selectivos de:

• Administración General del Estado

• Comunidades Autónomas

• Administración Local / Ayuntamientos

• Instituciones Penitenciarias

• Seguridad Social

• Sanidad

• Otros organismos públicos

En las convocatorias autonómicas y locales, la legislación de cada comunidad marca la diferencia. Por eso queremos contar con preparadores de todas las comunidades autónomas , que conozcan de primera mano la normativa y los procesos de su territorio.
🌟 Quiénes somos
En Polaris x Ucademy preparamos oposiciones de una forma más digital, práctica y personalizada. Ya hemos acompañado a miles de opositores y tenemos un objetivo claro: que 10.000 personas consigan su plaza preparándose con nosotros .
Para lograrlo, estamos ampliando nuestro claustro de preparadores de alto rendimiento .
Somos muy digitales, pero lo humano no se negocia . La tecnología nos ayuda a enseñar mejor, y son nuestros preparadores quienes aportan conocimiento, criterio, cercanía y acompañamiento.
🔎 A quién buscamos

• Profesionales del ámbito social con plaza (funcionarios/as o personal laboral fijo, en activo o en excedencia) en alguna de estas categorías.

• Preparadores/as con experiencia en estas oposiciones.

•
Personas capaces de trabajar las dos caras de la oposición :

• el contenido propio de la profesión (intervención, metodología, recursos, ética…),

• y la legislación y el contenido específico de la administración que convoca, incluida la normativa autonómica de su comunidad.

• Quienes dominen los supuestos prácticos , clave en la mayoría de estas oposiciones.

• Quienes sepan enseñar y acompañar : explicar con claridad, dar feedback útil y ayudar a sostener la preparación.

• Soltura con herramientas digitales . Si ya utilizas IA en tu día a día, mucho mejor.

🎯 En qué podrás colaborar
Según tu categoría, las administraciones que conozcas y tu disponibilidad, podrás participar en uno o varios proyectos:

• Clases online del temario profesional y del temario específico de cada administración.

• Supuestos prácticos: diseñarlos, resolverlos y corregir los de los alumnos.

• Legislación específica (servicios sociales, dependencia, menores, igualdad, ejecución penal, Seguridad Social…) según la convocatoria.

• Preguntas tipo test y simulacros con el formato real.

• Preparación de pruebas orales o de defensa , cuando la convocatoria las incluya.

• Seguimiento de alumnos: resolver dudas y ayudarles a avanzar.

• Temarios, esquemas, resúmenes y vídeos cortos.

🤝 Cómo funciona la colaboración
No es un puesto de trabajo a jornada completa ni parcial. Colaborarás con Polaris x Ucademy mediante prestación de servicios en proyectos educa

As Principal, Business Operations at Greenbox Capital , you will help define how the company operates, scales, and makes decisions.
You will transform ambiguous business problems into clear workflows, operating models, business rules, implementation requirements, and measurable operating outcomes across underwriting, renewals, funding, servicing, sales, risk, product, data, and technology.
This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who can move from diagnosis through implementation. You will identify operational friction, design future-state processes, align cross-functional stakeholders, support rollout and adoption, and measure whether the change deliveredmeaningful business impact.

• Transform complex or inconsistent workflows into scalable, adopted operating processes.

• Reduce friction, rework, delays, manual touches, and unclear ownership.

• Improve outcomes tied to conversion, productivity, speed, capacity, customer or broker experience, risk controls, margin, or cost efficiency.

• Lead workflow redesign from initial diagnosis through pilot, rollout, adoption, and measurement.

• Build alignment across executives, frontline teams, and Product, Technology, Data, Engineering, and Operations.

• Create implementation plans, stakeholder communications, SOP updates, training materials, and enablement resources.

• Influence teams and drive behavior change without direct authority.

• Identify risks, manage tradeoffs, escalate blockers, and maintain accountability across stakeholders.

description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X .

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote position. We are looking for candidates in the USA time zones.

Senior Software Engineer - Session Replay

The Opportunity:

The Session Replay squad is building a new Grafana Cloud product that helps our customers to understand what users actually experienced when something goes wrong.

Session Replay connects frontend signals (errors, performance, synthetic checks) to concrete session-level evidence, enabling faster and more confident investigation of production issues.

This team works at the intersection of:

• frontend observability,

• backend data processing and storage at scale,

• debugging workflows across products,

• privacy and access control,

• performance and cost constraints at scale.

Session Replay is still early, which means you’ll help shape both what we build and how it fits into Grafana Cloud. A key part of our next phase is evolving the backend architecture of capturing sessions, including a migration toward columnar/analytical solution as a primary storage and query engine for high-volume session data.

As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a new perspective to the software. We are looking for Senior Software Engineers who are passionate about working with data and providing seamless experiences for our customers to join our growing team! Our stack is Golang, Typescript and React, but we build tools for people using many other stacks. 

What You’ll Be Doing:

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will operate as a technical leader and systems thinker, driving both product direction and architectural evolution, specifically, you will:

• Own end-to-end technical direction for Session Replay, spanning frontend, backend, and data systems

• Drive the evolution of our backend architecture, including:

• Designing systems around columnar/analytical data storage for large-scale session data  

• Defining data models, ingestion pipelines, and query patterns

• Lead the design of investigation workflows, connecting replay with logs, metrics, traces and other telemetry across Grafana Cloud

• Make high-leverage architectural decisions that impact multiple teams and products

• Partner with teams across Grafana (Frontend Observability, Synthetic Monitoring, Core Grafana) to build cohesive cross-product experiences

• Engage directly with customers - joining calls, gathering structured feedback, and helping customers instrument and adopt Session Replay successfully. 

• Improve engineering standards, patterns, and operational practices

title: Candidature spontanée Eco-Compteur
description:
🚲Chez Eco-Compteur, nous accompagnons les villes dans leur transition vers le développement des mobilités douces et aidons à la préservation des plus beaux sites naturels du monde !
L’objectif ? Donner aux gestionnaires d’espaces naturels et aux villes des données de fréquentation terrain fiables pour les aider à prendre des décisions objectives : « Faut-il pérenniser cette piste cyclable temporaire ? Faut-il moduler le nombre de visiteurs pour préserver ce site naturel protégé ? »
Depuis 20 ans, nous proposons des solutions connectées pour le comptage de piétons et cyclistes en environnement urbain et naturel. Solutions qui vont des capteurs installés sur les pistes cyclables et les sentiers de randonnées aux logiciels d’interprétation des données. Parce que compter c’est bien mais donner du sens aux chiffres c’est encore mieux !
Focalisés sur l’innovation et l’international, nous sommes leader mondial d’un métier que nous avons créé ! 💪
Implanté en Bretagne avec des filiales au Canada, en Allemagne et à Shanghai, Eco-Compteur est aussi présent dans plus de 56 pays. C’est aussi et surtout une entreprise de taille humaine où chacun partage une vision et des valeurs : autonomie, confiance & transparence avec beaucoup de passion et de plaisir !
Requirements
Vous aussi vous voulez avoir un impact dans la transformation des villes de demain et participer au développement du tourisme durable ? Rejoignez-nous et devenez acteur dans le développement des villes intelligentes et la préservation des espaces naturels. Nous sommes en recherche perpétuelle de nouveaux talents prêts à relever les défis de demain (Lannion, Rennes, Montreal, Düsseldorf ..) !
Vous êtes passionné.e par la randonnée, le vélo (d’ailleurs vous ne comptez même plus les kilomètres !) et les sports de pleine nature de manière générale, nos valeurs - autonomie, confiance & transparence - vous font écho, alors nous avons plus que hâte d'échanger avec vous ! 🚲
Rejoindre Eco-Compteur c'est :
📈Des marchés en forte croissance, un contexte international, de nouveaux enjeux et défis à relever ensemble chaque jour
🚲Une équipe passionnée et à taille humaine, sur un site regroupant tous les métiers (conception, développement, fabrication, support…) tout est 100% made in France
💪🏻 Autonomie & Responsabilisation : ici vous pourrez tester, rater, réessayer, réaliser
🌊 Des bureaux à 10 minutes de la Côte de Granit Rose : Une baignade entre 12h et 14h, une session paddle ou juste détente sur le sable !
🎉Une entreprise classée Great Place to Work 2022 (12ème au classement!) 2019 et 2017
👏La fierté de reconnaitre nos produits en vacances, sur chaque sentier de randonnée, ou dans les rues des plus belles villes du monde
Highlights
Rejoignez nous pour avoir de l’impact sur le développement des mobilités durables et la protection des espaces naturels !

Product knowledge

title: Hadoop Big Data Developer
description:
Hadoop Big Data Developer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Hadoop Big Data Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000-$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 10+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are seeking an experienced Hadoop Big Data Developer to design, build, and operate large-scale data processing pipelines and analytics platforms on Hadoop and related big-data ecosystems. In this role you will be responsible for ingesting, transforming, and analyzing massive volumes of structured and unstructured data to support enterprise analytics, machine learning, and reporting workloads. The ideal candidate will combine deep technical expertise across the Hadoop ecosystem with strong software engineering fundamentals and a clear understanding of how to deliver reliable, performant, and cost-effective data platforms in production environments.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Five or more years of professional experience designing and operating big-data pipelines on Hadoop.

• Strong hands-on expertise with Apache Spark (Scala, Python, or Java) in production environments.

• Solid experience with Hive, HDFS, Sqoop, HBase, and the broader Hadoop ecosystem.

• Hands-on experience with streaming data platforms such as Kafka, Spark Streaming, or Flink.

• Strong SQL skills and experience working with both relational and NoSQL data stores.

• Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow or Oozie.

• Solid understanding of distributed systems concepts, including partitioning, replication, and fault tolerance.

• Strong scripting skills in Python or Shell.

• Excellent troubleshooting, debugging, and documentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience operating Hadoop on cloud platforms such as AWS EMR, Azure HDInsight, or Databricks.

• Familiarity with modern lakehouse formats (Delta, Iceberg, Hudi).

• Exposure to data governance tooling such as Apache Atlas or Collibra.

• Experience with Kubernetes-based data platforms (Spark-on-K8s, Trino).

• Hands-on experience with CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code in data engineering workflows.

NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). OCD is one of the most severe, prevalent, and misunderstood mental health conditions. NOCD creates access to online therapy for people with OCD through our telehealth platform. In the NOCD app, Members can quickly access and schedule live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy (ERP) - considered the "gold standard" in OCD treatment.

At NOCD , we help people reclaim their lives with clinically proven OCD treatment, by removing barriers to OCD care, and reducing the stigma associated with OCD. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Simulation
description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver-The World's Most Experienced Driver™-to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

The Simulator team builds state-of-the-art simulations of realistic environments for the testing and training of the Waymo driver. We use machine learning to model the real world, including realistic agents (vehicles, pedestrians, cyclists, motorcyclists etc.), roads, traffic control systems, and weather. To increase the fidelity and steerability of the simulations, we employ large foundation models, trained on our massive datasets that allow us to quickly setup and rollout multiple scenarios to subject our driver to.

 

We are planning to set up a team in London UK to work with the teams in MTV and Oxford to build these foundation models out and to integrate them into several evaluation and training products. We are looking for research engineers to work on these exciting problems.

In this hybrid role, you will report to an Engineering Director.
